# Image map — `unpacked/sonnet_img.bin`

**GENERATED by `re/tools/imgmap.mjs`. Do not hand-edit.**

Every row is read from the module that depends on it (the audio port's
stream table, codec0's constants, `poem.json`'s own `table_va`,
`timeline.json`'s `source`, the generated resource-archive header,
`re/oracle/names.json`), so this cannot drift from the runtime. Regenerate
after any of those change.

## Where the file came from

`originals/threestate/3s-sonnet/sonnet.exe` — 65,536 B, the whole 64k budget
to the byte — packed with **ryg's packer** (the PE sections are named
`rygs and` / `packer. `; the nfo thanks "Ryg (Packer)"). An aPLib-style LZ
(MSB-first tag bits, gamma lengths, offset thresholds 0x7D00/0x500/0x7F,
simplified: repeat-offset on gamma==2 is unconditional), followed by an E8/E9
call filter with exactly 0x851 rel32 fixups. `work-sonnet/unpack.py` unpacks it
statically and byte-faithfully — the stub was transcribed from ndisasm at file
offset 0xfcc0. OEP 0x4042d3. See `re/ANALYSIS.md` §1.

**VA 0x401000 == file offset 0.** 541299 bytes, VA 0x401000..0x485273.

## Unattributed

What nobody has named yet. `zero` is the fraction of zero bytes and `H` the
byte entropy in bits — a run at `zero≈1.00` is the allocator's zero-fill and
uninteresting; anything with `H > 4` is real data still to be identified.

| VA start | VA end | size | zero | H | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x47460e` | `0x485000` | 68,082 | 1.00 | 0.0 | zero-fill |
| `0x418dd7` | `0x41a048` | 4,721 | 0.89 | 1.2 | 103 cited constants — the float32 literal pool, analysed in re/ANALYSIS.md §7b |

Of the 194 distinct data addresses the port cites in its comments,
186 fall outside every named region above — those are the constant pool.
